description: PRoctor Stop hook — auto-continue when a /proctor:proctor pipeline is mid-flight. Without this, Claude Code's turn-model has the AI naturally end its turn after each tool call, stalling the state-machine loop between every stage and forcing the user to type '继续' / 'continue'. The hook detects an active pipeline-state.json (step != 'done', mtime within 5 minutes) and exits 2 with stderr so Claude Code treats it as a 'continue' instruction.
